newsitem.title: USA: Dakotah restates Q2, Q3 1996 results.
newsitem.headline: Dakotah restates Q2, Q3 1996 results.

text.p: Dakotah Inc said Tuesday it restated its results for the second and third quarters of 1996.
As a result, the company's restated second quarter is a net loss of $219,000 or $0.06 a share compared with previously reported net earnings of $47,000 or $0.01 a share.
For the third quarter, restated net earnings increased to $451,000 or $0.13 a share from previously reported earnings of $348,000 or $0.10 a share.

Dakotah, which makes decorative pillows, table linens and other home accessories, said it restated the results to reflect a $350,000 increase in the cost of goods sold and an $80,000 decrease in operating expenses.
